channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: The Vermont Statehouse received its Christmas tree from the Delphas family of Rutland. The tree will be displayed as part of the holiday decorations. This marks the start of the festive season at the Statehouse.
Killington's Select Board banned pets in town buildings except the library. The rule does not apply to service animals. The vote followed concerns about a dog causing an asthma attack in Town Hall.

Bromley Mountain Ski Resort has delayed its opening day to next weekend despite snowmaking efforts. Stratton Mountain and Bolton Valley have also postponed openings, with Bolton Valley aiming for December fifth. Jay Peak will open Friday with a special event for season passholders and guests.

Rutland Northeast Supervisory Union previewed a fourteen point six million dollar budget for fiscal year twenty-twenty-eight. The budget includes teacher raises and higher transportation costs. Special education reductions are planned but services remain protected by law.
